description: Phase C — Normal continuation: PingPong clip with sectionBehavior=Normal keeps cycling forward / reverse past the break. 16-frame PNG sequence (30fps source, 30fps timeline) extended to 200 timeline frames; section break at timeline frame 8. With Locked, the timeline-derived path would freeze the source frame at 8. With Normal+PingPong, SectionScheduler seeds ClipPlaybackPhase=8 (cycle 0, forward) and advances it each at-break tick -- the phase drifts forward, then reflects back past sourceLength=16. Asserts mediaFrame is NOT 8 by the end of the at-break wait, exercising the reflection branch in the entity-aware mapToMediaFrame. WaitSeconds 1.6 → drift ~1.33s × 30fps + seed 8 = phase ~47 → cycle-2 forward peak (mediaFrame 15). PingPong cycle period is sourceLength*2 = 32 (NOT 30); see SectionScheduler::mapToMediaFrame. Phase 47 ±4 jitter stays in mediaFrame [11, 15], well outside the bad zone [6, 10] so the assertion is robust under typical -j 1 jitter.
